verses.ar: الٓرٰࣞ تِلۡكَ اٰيٰتُ الۡكِتٰبِ وَقُرۡاٰنٍ مُّبِيۡنٍ
verses.en: Alif, Lām, Rā. These are verses of the Book and the enlightening Qur’ān.

verses.ar: رُبَمَا يَوَدُّ الَّذِيۡنَ كَفَرُوۡا لَوۡ كَانُوۡا مُسۡلِمِيۡنَ
verses.en: On many occasions, the disbelievers will wish that they were Muslims.

verses.ar: ذَرۡهُمۡ يَاۡكُلُوۡا وَيَتَمَتَّعُوۡا وَيُلۡهِهِمُ الۡاَمَلُ فَسَوۡفَ يَعۡلَمُوۡنَ
verses.en: Let them eat and enjoy, and let (their) fancy make them neglectful, for they shall soon come to know (their ultimate end).

verses.ar: وَمَا٘ اَهۡلَكۡنَا مِنۡ قَرۡيَةٍ اِلَّا وَلَهَا كِتَابٌ مَّعۡلُوۡمٌ
verses.en: We did not destroy any town without having a pre-determined time for it.

verses.ar: مَا تَسۡبِقُ مِنۡ اُمَّةٍ اَجَلَهَا وَمَا يَسۡتَاۡخِرُوۡنَ
verses.en: No people can precede their appointed time, nor can they exceed it.

verses.ar: وَقَالُوۡا يٰ٘اَيُّهَا الَّذِيۡ نُزِّلَ عَلَيۡهِ الذِّكۡرُ اِنَّكَ لَمَجۡنُوۡنٌؕ‏
verses.en: They say, “O you to whom the Dhikr (the Qur’ān) has been revealed, you are surely insane.

verses.ar: لَوۡمَا تَاۡتِيۡنَا بِالۡمَلٰٓئِكَةِ اِنۡ كُنۡتَ مِنَ الصّٰدِقِيۡنَ
verses.en: Why do you not bring the angels to us, if you are one of the truthful?”

verses.ar: مَا نُنَزِّلُ الۡمَلٰٓئِكَةَ اِلَّا بِالۡحَقِّ وَمَا كَانُوۡ٘ا اِذًا مُّنۡظَرِيۡنَ
verses.en: We do not send down the angels except with truth, and then they shall be given no respite.

verses.ar: اِنَّا نَحۡنُ نَزَّلۡنَا الذِّكۡرَ وَاِنَّا لَهٗ لَحٰفِظُوۡنَ
verses.en: We, Ourselves, have sent down the Dhikr (the Qur’ān), and We are there to protect it.

verses.ar: وَلَقَدۡ اَرۡسَلۡنَا مِنۡ قَبۡلِكَ فِيۡ شِيَعِ الۡاَوَّلِيۡنَ
verses.en: We did send the messengers before you among the groups of earlier peoples.

verses.ar: وَمَا يَاۡتِيۡهِمۡ مِّنۡ رَّسُوۡلٍ اِلَّا كَانُوۡا بِهٖ يَسۡتَهۡزِءُوۡنَ
verses.en: No messenger came to them but they used to mock at him.

verses.ar: كَذٰلِكَ نَسۡلُكُهٗ فِيۡ قُلُوۡبِ الۡمُجۡرِمِيۡنَۙ‏
verses.en: Likewise, We make it (i.e. disbelief) enter into the hearts of the sinners,

verses.ar: لَا يُؤۡمِنُوۡنَ بِهٖ وَقَدۡ خَلَتۡ سُنَّةُ الۡاَوَّلِيۡنَ
verses.en: (whereby) they do not believe in it (the Qur’ān), and this has been the way of earlier people.

verses.ar: وَلَوۡ فَتَحۡنَا عَلَيۡهِمۡ بَابًا مِّنَ السَّمَآءِ فَظَلُّوۡا فِيۡهِ يَعۡرُجُوۡنَۙ‏
verses.en: Even if We open a gate in the sky and they keep ascending through it,

verses.ar: لَقَالُوۡ٘ا اِنَّمَا سُكِّرَتۡ اَبۡصَارُنَا بَلۡ نَحۡنُ قَوۡمٌ مَّسۡحُوۡرُوۡنَࣖ‏
verses.en: still they will say, “In fact our eyes have been deluded; rather we are enchanted people.

verses.ar: وَلَقَدۡ جَعَلۡنَا فِي السَّمَآءِ بُرُوۡجًا وَّزَيَّنّٰهَا لِلنّٰظِرِيۡنَۙ‏
verses.en: We have created stellar formations in the sky and have beautified them for onlookers,

verses.ar: وَحَفِظۡنٰهَا مِنۡ كُلِّ شَيۡطٰنٍ رَّجِيۡمٍۙ‏
verses.en: and have protected them from every outcast devil,

verses.ar: اِلَّا مَنِ اسۡتَرَقَ السَّمۡعَ فَاَتۡبَعَهٗ شِهَابٌ مُّبِيۡنٌ
verses.en: but the one who tries to eavesdrop is chased by a clearly visible flame.

verses.ar: وَالۡاَرۡضَ مَدَدۡنٰهَا وَاَلۡقَيۡنَا فِيۡهَا رَوَاسِيَ وَاَنۭۡ بَتۡنَا فِيۡهَا مِنۡ كُلِّ شَيۡءٍ مَّوۡزُوۡنٍ
verses.en: As for the earth, We have stretched it out and placed on it firm mountains, and We have caused to grow in it everything well-balanced,

verses.ar: وَجَعَلۡنَا لَكُمۡ فِيۡهَا مَعَايِشَ وَمَنۡ لَّسۡتُمۡ لَهٗ بِرٰزِقِيۡنَ
verses.en: and created in it sources of sustenance for you and those (creatures) for whom you are not the sustainers.

verses.ar: وَاِنۡ مِّنۡ شَيۡءٍ اِلَّا عِنۡدَنَا خَزَآئِنُهٗؗ وَمَا نُنَزِّلُهٗ٘ اِلَّا بِقَدَرٍ مَّعۡلُوۡمٍ
verses.en: We have treasures of every thing, but We send it down only in a determined quantity.

verses.ar: وَاَرۡسَلۡنَا الرِّيٰحَ لَوَاقِحَ فَاَنۡزَلۡنَا مِنَ السَّمَآءِ مَآءً فَاَسۡقَيۡنٰكُمُوۡهُۚ وَمَا٘ اَنۡتُمۡ لَهٗ بِخٰزِنِيۡنَ
verses.en: And We sent forth winds carrying the clouds, then sent down water from the sky and gave it to you to drink, and you are not able to store it.

verses.ar: وَاِنَّا لَنَحۡنُ نُحۡيٖ وَنُمِيۡتُ وَنَحۡنُ الۡوٰرِثُوۡنَ
verses.en: It is indeed We, and only We, who give life and bring death, and We are the ultimate inheritor (of everything).

verses.ar: وَلَقَدۡ عَلِمۡنَا الۡمُسۡتَقۡدِمِيۡنَ مِنۡكُمۡ وَلَقَدۡ عَلِمۡنَا الۡمُسۡتَاۡخِرِيۡنَ
verses.en: We know those of you who went ahead, and We know those who remained late.

verses.ar: وَاِنَّ رَبَّكَ هُوَ يَحۡشُرُهُمۡؕ اِنَّهٗ حَكِيۡمٌ عَلِيۡمٌࣖ‏
verses.en: Surely, your Lord will gather all of them together. Indeed He is All-Wise, All-Knowing.

verses.ar: وَلَقَدۡ خَلَقۡنَا الۡاِنۡسَانَ مِنۡ صَلۡصَالٍ مِّنۡ حَمَاٍ مَّسۡنُوۡنٍۚ‏
verses.en: Indeed We created man from a ringing clay made of decayed mud.

verses.ar: وَالۡجَآنَّ خَلَقۡنٰهُ مِنۡ قَبۡلُ مِنۡ نَّارِ السَّمُوۡمِ
verses.en: As for the Jānn (the first Jinn), We had created him earlier from the fire of the scorching wind.

verses.ar: وَاِذۡ قَالَ رَبُّكَ لِلۡمَلٰٓئِكَةِ اِنِّيۡ خَالِقٌۭ بَشَرًا مِّنۡ صَلۡصَالٍ مِّنۡ حَمَاٍ مَّسۡنُوۡنٍ
verses.en: Recall when your Lord said to the angels, “I am going to create a human being from a ringing clay made of decayed mud.

verses.ar: فَاِذَا سَوَّيۡتُهٗ وَنَفَخۡتُ فِيۡهِ مِنۡ رُّوۡحِيۡ فَقَعُوۡا لَهٗ سٰجِدِيۡنَ
verses.en: When I form him perfect, and blow in him of My spirit, then you must fall down before him in prostration.”

verses.ar: فَسَجَدَ الۡمَلٰٓئِكَةُ كُلُّهُمۡ اَجۡمَعُوۡنَۙ‏
verses.en: So the angels prostrated themselves, all together,

verses.ar: اِلَّا٘ اِبۡلِيۡسَؕ اَبٰ٘ي اَنۡ يَّكُوۡنَ مَعَ السّٰجِدِيۡنَ
verses.en: except Iblīs (Satan). He refused to join those who prostrated.

verses.ar: قَالَ يٰ٘اِبۡلِيۡسُ مَا لَكَ اَلَّا تَكُوۡنَ مَعَ السّٰجِدِيۡنَ
verses.en: He (Allah) said, “O Iblīs, what is the matter with you that you did not join those who prostrated?”

verses.ar: قَالَ لَمۡ اَكُنۡ لِّاَسۡجُدَ لِبَشَرٍ خَلَقۡتَهٗ مِنۡ صَلۡصَالٍ مِّنۡ حَمَاٍ مَّسۡنُوۡنٍ
verses.en: He said, “I am not such that I should prostrate myself before a mortal whom You have created from a ringing clay made of decayed mud.”

verses.ar: قَالَ فَاخۡرُجۡ مِنۡهَا فَاِنَّكَ رَجِيۡمٌۙ‏
verses.en: He said, “Then, get out of here, for you are an outcast,

verses.ar: وَّاِنَّ عَلَيۡكَ اللَّعۡنَةَ اِلٰي يَوۡمِ الدِّيۡنِ
verses.en: and upon you is the curse up to the Day of Judgment.”

verses.ar: قَالَ رَبِّ فَاَنۡظِرۡنِيۡ٘ اِلٰي يَوۡمِ يُبۡعَثُوۡنَ
verses.en: He said, “My Lord, then give me respite up to the day they (the dead) shall be raised.”

verses.ar: قَالَ فَاِنَّكَ مِنَ الۡمُنۡظَرِيۡنَۙ‏
verses.en: He (Allah) said, “Well, respite is given to you

verses.ar: اِلٰي يَوۡمِ الۡوَقۡتِ الۡمَعۡلُوۡمِ
verses.en: till the day of the Appointed Time.”

verses.ar: قَالَ رَبِّ بِمَا٘ اَغۡوَيۡتَنِيۡ لَاُزَيِّنَنَّ لَهُمۡ فِي الۡاَرۡضِ وَلَاُغۡوِيَنَّهُمۡ اَجۡمَعِيۡنَۙ‏
verses.en: He said, “My Lord, since You made me go astray, I swear that I shall beautify for them (evils) on the earth, and shall lead all of them astray,

verses.ar: اِلَّا عِبَادَكَ مِنۡهُمُ الۡمُخۡلَصِيۡنَ
verses.en: except those of Your servants from among them who are chosen (by You).”

verses.ar: قَالَ هٰذَا صِرَاطٌ عَلَيَّ مُسۡتَقِيۡمٌ
verses.en: He (Allah) said, “This is the straight path leading to Me (that a person is chosen by Me through his good deeds).

verses.ar: اِنَّ عِبَادِيۡ لَيۡسَ لَكَ عَلَيۡهِمۡ سُلۡطٰنٌ اِلَّا مَنِ اتَّبَعَكَ مِنَ الۡغٰوِيۡنَ
verses.en: My servants are such that you have no power over them except those of the deviators who will follow you.

verses.ar: وَاِنَّ جَهَنَّمَ لَمَوۡعِدُهُمۡ اَجۡمَعِيۡنَۙ‏
verses.en: And Jahannam (Hell) is the promised place for them all.

verses.ar: لَهَا سَبۡعَةُ اَبۡوَابٍؕ لِكُلِّ بَابٍ مِّنۡهُمۡ جُزۡءٌ مَّقۡسُوۡمٌࣖ‏
verses.en: It has seven gates. For each gate there is a group apportioned from them.”

verses.ar: اِنَّ الۡمُتَّقِيۡنَ فِيۡ جَنّٰتٍ وَّعُيُوۡنٍؕ‏
verses.en: Surely, the God-fearing will be in gardens and streams:

verses.ar: اُدۡخُلُوۡهَا بِسَلٰمٍ اٰمِنِيۡنَ
verses.en: “Enter here in peace, free of fear.”

verses.ar: وَنَزَعۡنَا مَا فِيۡ صُدُوۡرِهِمۡ مِّنۡ غِلٍّ اِخۡوَانًا عَلٰي سُرُرٍ مُّتَقٰبِلِيۡنَ
verses.en: We shall have removed whatever grudge they had in their hearts, (thus making them) brothers, sitting on couches, face to face.

verses.ar: لَا يَمَسُّهُمۡ فِيۡهَا نَصَبٌ وَّمَا هُمۡ مِّنۡهَا بِمُخۡرَجِيۡنَ
verses.en: No weariness shall touch them nor will they be expelled from there.

verses.ar: نَبِّئۡ عِبَادِيۡ٘ اَنِّيۡ٘ اَنَا الۡغَفُوۡرُ الرَّحِيۡمُۙ‏
verses.en: Tell My servants that I am the Most-Forgiving, the Very-Merciful

verses.ar: وَاَنَّ عَذَابِيۡ هُوَ الۡعَذَابُ الۡاَلِيۡمُ
verses.en: and that My punishment is the painful punishment,

verses.ar: وَنَبِّئۡهُمۡ عَنۡ ضَيۡفِ اِبۡرٰهِيۡمَۘ‏
verses.en: and tell them about the guests of Ibrāhīm.

verses.ar: اِذۡ دَخَلُوۡا عَلَيۡهِ فَقَالُوۡا سَلٰمًاؕ قَالَ اِنَّا مِنۡكُمۡ وَجِلُوۡنَ
verses.en: When they visited him, they greeted him with Salām (peace on you). He said, “We are scared of you.”

verses.ar: قَالُوۡا لَا تَوۡجَلۡ اِنَّا نُبَشِّرُكَ بِغُلٰمٍ عَلِيۡمٍ
verses.en: They said, “Do not be scared. We give you good news of a boy who will be knowledgeable.”

verses.ar: قَالَ اَبَشَّرۡتُمُوۡنِيۡ عَلٰ٘ي اَنۡ مَّسَّنِيَ الۡكِبَرُ فَبِمَ تُبَشِّرُوۡنَ
verses.en: He said, “Do you give me the good news despite the old age has befallen me? So what good news you are giving to me?”

verses.ar: قَالُوۡا بَشَّرۡنٰكَ بِالۡحَقِّ فَلَا تَكُنۡ مِّنَ الۡقٰنِطِيۡنَ
verses.en: They said, “We have given to you the good news of a fact. So do not be one of those who lose hope.”

verses.ar: قَالَ وَمَنۡ يَّقۡنَطُ مِنۡ رَّحۡمَةِ رَبِّهٖ٘ اِلَّا الضَّآلُّوۡنَ
verses.en: He said, “Who can lose hope in the mercy of his Lord except those who have lost the straight path?”

verses.ar: قَالَ فَمَا خَطۡبُكُمۡ اَيُّهَا الۡمُرۡسَلُوۡنَ
verses.en: He said, “Then, what is your mission, O messengers?”

verses.ar: قَالُوۡ٘ا اِنَّا٘ اُرۡسِلۡنَا٘ اِلٰي قَوۡمٍ مُّجۡرِمِيۡنَۙ‏
verses.en: They said, “We have been sent to a sinful people,

verses.ar: اِلَّا٘ اٰلَ لُوۡطٍؕ اِنَّا لَمُنَجُّوۡهُمۡ اَجۡمَعِيۡنَۙ‏
verses.en: except the family of LūT - all of whom we shall save,

verses.ar: اِلَّا امۡرَاَتَهٗ قَدَّرۡنَا٘ۙ اِنَّهَا لَمِنَ الۡغٰبِرِيۡنَࣖ‏
verses.en: but his wife. We have ordained that she will be among those who will remain behind.”

verses.ar: فَلَمَّا جَآءَ اٰلَ لُوۡطِ اِۨلۡمُرۡسَلُوۡنَۙ‏
verses.en: So when the messengers came to the family of LūT,

verses.ar: قَالَ اِنَّكُمۡ قَوۡمٌ مُّنۡكَرُوۡنَ
verses.en: he said, “You are an unfamiliar people.”

verses.ar: قَالُوۡا بَلۡ جِئۡنٰكَ بِمَا كَانُوۡا فِيۡهِ يَمۡتَرُوۡنَ
verses.en: They said, “No, but we have brought to you that (scourge) in which they have been doubting,

verses.ar: وَاَتَيۡنٰكَ بِالۡحَقِّ وَاِنَّا لَصٰدِقُوۡنَ
verses.en: and we have come to you with a definite matter and surely we are truthful.

verses.ar: فَاَسۡرِ بِاَهۡلِكَ بِقِطۡعٍ مِّنَ الَّيۡلِ وَاتَّبِعۡ اَدۡبَارَهُمۡ وَلَا يَلۡتَفِتۡ مِنۡكُمۡ اَحَدٌ وَّامۡضُوۡا حَيۡثُ تُؤۡمَرُوۡنَ
verses.en: So, carry your family after a part of the night (has passed), and follow them at the rear (to make sure that all of your family has joined you), and no one from you should look back; and keep going to where you are commanded.”

verses.ar: وَقَضَيۡنَا٘ اِلَيۡهِ ذٰلِكَ الۡاَمۡرَ اَنَّ دَابِرَ هٰ٘ؤُلَآءِ مَقۡطُوۡعٌ مُّصۡبِحِيۡنَ
verses.en: We conveyed to him Our decision that they (the unbelievers) were to be totally uprooted when they would see the morning.

verses.ar: وَجَآءَ اَهۡلُ الۡمَدِيۡنَةِ يَسۡتَبۡشِرُوۡنَ
verses.en: And the people of the city came rejoicing.

verses.ar: قَالَ اِنَّ هٰ٘ؤُلَآءِ ضَيۡفِيۡ فَلَا تَفۡضَحُوۡنِۙ‏
verses.en: He (LūT) said, “They are my guests; so do not put me to shame,

verses.ar: وَاتَّقُوا اللّٰهَ وَلَا تُخۡزُوۡنِ
verses.en: and fear Allah and do not disgrace me.”

verses.ar: قَالُوۡ٘ا اَوَلَمۡ نَنۡهَكَ عَنِ الۡعٰلَمِيۡنَ
verses.en: They said, “Had we not forbidden you from (being the guardian of) the whole world?”

verses.ar: قَالَ هٰ٘ؤُلَآءِ بَنَاتِيۡ٘ اِنۡ كُنۡتُمۡ فٰعِلِيۡنَؕ‏
verses.en: He said, “These are my daughters, if you are to do something.”

verses.ar: لَعَمۡرُكَ اِنَّهُمۡ لَفِيۡ سَكۡرَتِهِمۡ يَعۡمَهُوۡنَ
verses.en: By your life, (O prophet) they were wandering blindly in their intoxication (misguidance).

verses.ar: فَاَخَذَتۡهُمُ الصَّيۡحَةُ مُشۡرِقِيۡنَۙ‏
verses.en: So, they were seized by the Cry at sunrise.

verses.ar: فَجَعَلۡنَا عَالِيَهَا سَافِلَهَا وَاَمۡطَرۡنَا عَلَيۡهِمۡ حِجَارَةً مِّنۡ سِجِّيۡلٍؕ‏
verses.en: Then, We turned it (the city) upside down and rained down upon them stones of baked clay.

verses.ar: اِنَّ فِيۡ ذٰلِكَ لَاٰيٰتٍ لِّلۡمُتَوَسِّمِيۡنَ
verses.en: Surely, in that there are signs for those who read signs.

verses.ar: وَاِنَّهَا لَبِسَبِيۡلٍ مُّقِيۡمٍ
verses.en: Surely, it (their city) is located on the straight road.

verses.ar: اِنَّ فِيۡ ذٰلِكَ لَاٰيَةً لِّلۡمُؤۡمِنِيۡنَؕ‏
verses.en: Surely, in it there is a sign for the believers.

verses.ar: وَاِنۡ كَانَ اَصۡحٰبُ الۡاَيۡكَةِ لَظٰلِمِيۡنَۙ‏
verses.en: And the people of Aikah were (also) transgressors.

verses.ar: فَانۡتَقَمۡنَا مِنۡهُمۡۘ وَاِنَّهُمَا لَبِاِمَامٍ مُّبِيۡنٍؕࣖ‏
verses.en: So, We punished them in retribution, and both of them are (situated) by a highway, clearly visible.

verses.ar: وَلَقَدۡ كَذَّبَ اَصۡحٰبُ الۡحِجۡرِ الۡمُرۡسَلِيۡنَۙ‏
verses.en: And the people of Al-Hijr gave the lie to the messengers.

verses.ar: وَاٰتَيۡنٰهُمۡ اٰيٰتِنَا فَكَانُوۡا عَنۡهَا مُعۡرِضِيۡنَۙ‏
verses.en: We provided them with Our signs, yet they kept turning away from them.

verses.ar: وَكَانُوۡا يَنۡحِتُوۡنَ مِنَ الۡجِبَالِ بُيُوۡتًا اٰمِنِيۡنَ
verses.en: They used to hew out houses from the hills peacefully.

verses.ar: فَاَخَذَتۡهُمُ الصَّيۡحَةُ مُصۡبِحِيۡنَۙ‏
verses.en: Then, the Cry seized them by the morning.

verses.ar: فَمَا٘ اَغۡنٰي عَنۡهُمۡ مَّا كَانُوۡا يَكۡسِبُوۡنَؕ‏
verses.en: So, whatever they earned did not come to their help.

verses.ar: وَمَا خَلَقۡنَا السَّمٰوٰتِ وَالۡاَرۡضَ وَمَا بَيۡنَهُمَا٘ اِلَّا بِالۡحَقِّؕ وَاِنَّ السَّاعَةَ لَاٰتِيَةٌ فَاصۡفَحِ الصَّفۡحَ الۡجَمِيۡلَ
verses.en: We did not create the heavens and the earth and all that is in between them without a truthful purpose. The Hour is sure to come. Therefore, overlook (their evil behavior) in a gracious manner.

verses.ar: اِنَّ رَبَّكَ هُوَ الۡخَلّٰقُ الۡعَلِيۡمُ
verses.en: Surely, your Lord is the Creator of all, the All-Knowing.

verses.ar: وَلَقَدۡ اٰتَيۡنٰكَ سَبۡعًا مِّنَ الۡمَثَانِيۡ وَالۡقُرۡاٰنَ الۡعَظِيۡمَ
verses.en: We have given you the seven oft-repeated verses and the glorious Qur’ān.

verses.ar: لَا تَمُدَّنَّ عَيۡنَيۡكَ اِلٰي مَا مَتَّعۡنَا بِهٖ٘ اَزۡوَاجًا مِّنۡهُمۡ وَلَا تَحۡزَنۡ عَلَيۡهِمۡ وَاخۡفِضۡ جَنَاحَكَ لِلۡمُؤۡمِنِيۡنَ
verses.en: Never stretch your eyes towards what We have given to groups of them to enjoy, and do not grieve for them, and be kind to believers in humbleness,

verses.ar: وَقُلۡ اِنِّيۡ٘ اَنَا النَّذِيۡرُ الۡمُبِيۡنُۚ‏
verses.en: and say, “I am a plain warner indeed”

verses.ar: كَمَا٘ اَنۡزَلۡنَا عَلَي الۡمُقۡتَسِمِيۡنَۙ‏
verses.en: (to warn them that We may send down the scourge upon them) as We sent down upon the dividers.

verses.ar: الَّذِيۡنَ جَعَلُوا الۡقُرۡاٰنَ عِضِيۡنَ
verses.en: who had split the divine recitation (Scriptures) into bits.

verses.ar: فَوَرَبِّكَ لَنَسۡـَٔلَنَّهُمۡ اَجۡمَعِيۡنَۙ‏
verses.en: So, by your Lord, We shall question all of them.

verses.ar: عَمَّا كَانُوۡا يَعۡمَلُوۡنَࣔ‏
verses.en: about what they have been doing.

verses.ar: فَاصۡدَعۡ بِمَا تُؤۡمَرُ وَاَعۡرِضۡ عَنِ الۡمُشۡرِكِيۡنَ
verses.en: Now, proclaim what you are commanded to, and turn away from those who ascribe partners to Allah.

verses.ar: اِنَّا كَفَيۡنٰكَ الۡمُسۡتَهۡزِءِيۡنَۙ‏
verses.en: Surely, We are sufficient for you against those who deride,

verses.ar: الَّذِيۡنَ يَجۡعَلُوۡنَ مَعَ اللّٰهِ اِلٰهًا اٰخَرَۚ فَسَوۡفَ يَعۡلَمُوۡنَ
verses.en: - those who believe in any other god along with Allah. So, they shall soon learn (the reality).

verses.ar: وَلَقَدۡ نَعۡلَمُ اَنَّكَ يَضِيۡقُ صَدۡرُكَ بِمَا يَقُوۡلُوۡنَۙ‏
verses.en: We know that your heart feels distressed for what they say.

verses.ar: فَسَبِّحۡ بِحَمۡدِ رَبِّكَ وَكُنۡ مِّنَ السّٰجِدِيۡنَۙ‏
verses.en: So, proclaim the purity and glory of your Lord, and be among those who prostrate themselves (before Allah);

verses.ar: وَاعۡبُدۡ رَبَّكَ حَتّٰي يَاۡتِيَكَ الۡيَقِيۡنُࣖ‏
verses.en: and worship your Lord until comes to you that which is certain.
